1. The short version

  • Your audio never leaves your device. Recordings are converted and transcribed inside your browser.
  • If you save a transcript, its text is stored in your account.
  • If you use AI features (summaries, notes, insights, Create tools, Ask, quiz grading), the relevant transcript text (never audio) is sent to our AI provider, Anthropic, to produce the result.
  • We don't sell your data, show ads, or use analytics or advertising trackers.
  • You can delete your account and everything in it yourself, at any time, in Settings.

2. What we collect

Account information: your email address and password (stored only as a secure hash by our authentication provider), when you signed up and last signed in, and technical session details our authentication provider records (such as IP address and browser type). Optionally, a display name.

Content you save: transcript titles and text, speaker names you assign, timestamps, recording length, language and recording type, folders and favourites. If you use AI features: the summaries, notes, insights, study material, drafts, quizzes (and your quiz progress), and questions and answers they produce.

Usage records: how many seconds you've transcribed per saved recording, and a record of each AI action (which feature, when, how many AI tokens it used and what it cost us). We use these to run fair-use limits and to understand costs.

Technical data: our hosting and database providers keep short-lived logs of requests (IP address, time, page or API address, browser type). Our own AI usage log lines contain your account ID and the recording's ID, never its content.

Stored on your device: your preferences (theme, mascot, transcription settings, custom vocabulary), whether you've agreed to AI processing, small progress markers, a transcript waiting for you to sign in (kept for at most one hour), and the speech-recognition models (downloaded once; not personal). We use your browser's local storage for these and for keeping you signed in. We don't set advertising or analytics cookies. Legal review: cookie/local-storage notice requirements, e.g. ePrivacy

What we don't collect: your audio or video files, your contacts, location, or payment card details (when paid plans launch, payments will be handled by Stripe and we'll update this policy).

3. How we use it

  • To provide the service: transcribe on your device, save and show your library, and run the AI features you ask for.
  • To keep accounts secure: sign-in, password reset, email confirmation, fraud and abuse prevention, usage limits.
  • To keep costs sustainable: hourly and monthly AI limits per account and a service-wide daily cap.
  • To support you when you contact us, and to fix problems.
  • We don't use your transcripts to train AI models, and our AI provider doesn't either (see section 5).

Legal review Legal bases if GDPR applies: performance of a contract (providing the service), legitimate interests (security, abuse prevention, cost limits), legal obligation (accounting), consent (optional AI processing, where required).

5. AI processing

When you use an AI feature, we send the transcript text it needs (lines with speaker names and timestamps; for Ask, your question and the most relevant lines) to Anthropic's API. We never send audio. Anthropic processes it under its commercial terms, which To confirm: current Anthropic terms don't allow training on API data and keep inputs and outputs only for a limited period (for example up to 30 days, longer only if flagged for a usage-policy review). AI results are stored in your account until you delete them or your account. AI output can be wrong: check important details against the transcript.

7. Your choices and rights

  • Delete: Settings → Account → Delete account removes your account and everything in it immediately and permanently. Single recordings can be deleted in My Library.
  • Access and export: you can view everything in the app and export each transcript and AI result (TXT, Markdown, Word, PDF, subtitles). For a full copy of your account data, contact us. To confirm: response time, e.g. 30 days
  • Correct: edit speaker names and recording details in the app, or contact us.
  • AI features are optional: transcription works without them.
  • Depending on where you live, you may have more rights (access, portability, objection, restriction, complaint to a supervisory authority). Legal review

8. Recording other people

Recordings often contain other people's voices and personal information. You're responsible for having the right to record and transcribe them, including any consent your local law requires. Legal review: one- vs two-party consent jurisdictions

9. Security

Your audio stays on your device. Data in transit is encrypted (HTTPS), and stored data is protected by per-account access rules in our database: each account can only read its own records. No system is perfectly secure; if a breach affects you, we'll notify you as the law requires.

10. Children
